entry.title: Fretty 0.8.5
entry.summary: Sampled guitars (acoustic archtop, electric), harps, strumstick, violin, dan tranh and psaltery on a six-string playing model, with a synth layer, chord pads, drive, chorus, echo and space. All samples CC0. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. entry.title: Fretty 0.8.3
entry.summary: ### Fretty 0.8.3 - Refined UI typography and improved font consistency for selector values. - Standardized 80s preset category names. - Includes an updated catalog of 110 presets. - Improved skin-generation and live-preview tooling.
